batch_node.name: Anchore Pages v0.1.0
batch_node.description: The standard Anchore pages: vulnerabilities, images, one image, its SBOM, and collection health. Standard table, stat card and text panels over Gryphon searches; no custom panel type.

node.name: Anchore Pages
node.description: Links between the Anchore pages.

node.name: anchore — card-open
node.description: Findings Anchore currently reports.

node.name: anchore — card-severe
node.description: Current findings Anchore rates Critical or High.

query: MATCH (f:anchore__anchore_finding) WHERE f.data.state = "current" AND f.data.severity IN ["Critical", "High"]

node.name: anchore — card-fixable
node.description: Current findings for which Anchore names a fixed version.

node.name: anchore — card-kev
node.description: Current findings Anchore marks as on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list.

query: MATCH (f:anchore__anchore_finding) WHERE f.data.state = "current" AND f.data.is_kev = true

node.name: anchore — card-resolved
node.description: Findings Anchore reported earlier and no longer reports.

node.name: anchore — by-vulnerability
node.description: One row per vulnerability and package with a current finding, and how many images carry it.

query: RETURN f.data.vulnerability_id AS vuln, f.data.severity AS severity, f.data.package_name AS package, f.data.package_version AS version, f.data.fix AS fix, f.data.is_kev AS kev, COUNT(h) AS images

node.name: anchore — open-findings
node.description: Every current finding with the image it was found on.

query: RETURN f.data.vulnerability_id AS vuln, f.data.severity AS severity, f.data.package_name AS package, f.data.package_version AS version, f.data.fix AS fix, f.data.is_kev AS kev, f.data.detected_at AS detected, h.name AS image, h.data.stable_id AS digest

node.name: Open Findings
node.description: Findings Anchore currently reports.

node.name: Critical Or High
node.description: Current findings Anchore rates Critical or High.

node.name: Known Exploited
node.description: Current findings Anchore marks as on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list.

node.name: With A Fix

node.name: Resolved
node.description: Findings Anchore reported earlier and no longer reports.

node.name: What To Fix
node.description: Section heading: One row per vulnerability and package: the severity Anchore reported, the version that fixes it and how many images carry it. Counts are of findings Anchore currently reports on images it has analyzed; an image Anchore has not analyzed contributes nothing here, which is not the same as having no findings. See Images for those.

columns.title: Severity

columns.header_tooltip: The version Anchore says fixes it. None means Anchore reports no fix; blank means its record carried no fix field.

columns.title: CISA KEV
columns.header_tooltip: Whether Anchore marked it as on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list. Blank means Anchore's record did not say.

columns.title: Images
columns.header_tooltip: How many images carry a current finding for it in this package.

node.name: Where It Is
node.description: Section heading: One row per finding: the vulnerability, the package and the image it was found on. Click an image for everything Anchore holds about it.

config.text: One row per finding: the vulnerability, the package and the image it was found on. Click an image for everything Anchore holds about it.

node.name: Open Findings
node.description: Every current finding with its image.

columns.title: Severity
columns.header_tooltip: The severity Anchore reported, as returned.

columns.header_tooltip: The version Anchore says fixes it. None means Anchore reports no fix; blank means its record carried no fix field.

columns.title: Detected

node.name: Anchore Vulnerabilities
node.description: What Anchore currently reports: five counts, then every open vulnerability by package and every finding by image. Click an image for its findings and packages.

node.name: anchore — images
node.description: Every image record Anchore holds, with its analysis state.

query: RETURN i.data.reference AS image, i.data.image_digest AS digest, i.data.analysis_status AS status, i.data.image_status AS image_status, i.data.created_at AS created, i.data.last_updated AS updated

node.name: anchore — image-counts
node.description: Images with at least one current finding, and how many.

query: RETURN h.name AS image, h.data.stable_id AS digest, COUNT(f) AS findings

node.name: anchore — card-images
node.description: Image records Anchore holds.

node.name: anchore — card-images-analyzed
node.description: Image records whose analysis Anchore reports as finished.

node.name: anchore — card-images-pending
node.description: Image records whose analysis Anchore does not report as finished.

node.name: Images
node.description: Image records Anchore holds.

node.description: Image records whose analysis Anchore reports as finished.

node.name: Not Analyzed
node.description: Image records whose analysis Anchore does not report as finished; their findings were not read.

node.name: Every Image
node.description: Section heading: Every image record Anchore holds within this collection's scope. Analysis says whether Anchore finished analyzing it: findings and packages exist here only for analyzed images.

config.text: Every image record Anchore holds within this collection's scope. Analysis says whether Anchore finished analyzing it: findings and packages exist here only for analyzed images.

node.name: Images
node.description: Every image record Anchore holds.

columns.title: Analysis
columns.header_tooltip: Anchore's analysis state. Findings and packages are read only for an analyzed image; any other state means they were not read, not that there are none.

config.empty_text: Anchore holds no image in scope.

node.name: Images With Open Findings
node.description: Section heading: Images with at least one current finding, and how many. An image missing from this table has no current finding or was not analyzed; the table above says which.

config.text: Images with at least one current finding, and how many. An image missing from this table has no current finding or was not analyzed; the table above says which.

node.description: Images with at least one current finding.

config.empty_text: No image has a current finding.

node.name: Anchore Images
node.description: Every image Anchore holds, whether it finished analyzing it, and which carry open findings. Click an image for its detail.

node.name: anchore — image-identity
node.description: The selected image as Anchore records it.

query: RETURN i.data.reference AS image, i.data.image_digest AS digest, i.data.image_digest AS digest_text, i.data.analysis_status AS status, i.data.image_status AS image_status, i.data.parent_digest AS parent, i.data.created_at AS created, i.data.last_updated AS updated

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: anchore — image-tags
node.description: The tags that name the selected image.

query: RETURN t.data.registry AS registry, t.data.repository AS repository, t.data.tag AS tag

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: anchore — image-findings
node.description: Every finding on the selected image, current and resolved.

query: RETURN f.data.vulnerability_id AS vuln, f.data.severity AS severity, f.data.state AS state, f.data.package_name AS package, f.data.package_version AS version, f.data.package_type AS type, f.data.fix AS fix, f.data.is_kev AS kev, f.data.detected_at AS detected

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: Image
node.description: The selected image as Anchore records it.

columns.title: Analysis
columns.header_tooltip: Anchore's analysis state. Findings and packages are read only for an analyzed image; any other state means they were not read, not that there are none.

columns.title: Packages
columns.header_tooltip: The packages this image's SBOM lists.

config.empty_text: Anchore holds no image record with this digest. Open an image from the Images page.

node.name: Findings
node.description: Section heading: Every finding Anchore has reported on this image. Current means the latest read still reports it; resolved means an earlier read did and the latest does not. An image Anchore has not analyzed has no rows here because nothing was read, not because it is clean.

config.text: Every finding Anchore has reported on this image. Current means the latest read still reports it; resolved means an earlier read did and the latest does not. An image Anchore has not analyzed has no rows here because nothing was read, not because it is clean.

node.name: Findings On This Image
node.description: Current and resolved findings.

columns.title: Severity
columns.header_tooltip: The severity Anchore reported, as returned.

columns.title: Fixed In
columns.header_tooltip: The version Anchore says fixes it. None means Anchore reports no fix; blank means its record carried no fix field.

config.empty_text: No finding is recorded for this image.

node.name: Tags
node.description: Section heading: The registry, repository and tag names Anchore reports for this digest.

config.text: The registry, repository and tag names Anchore reports for this digest.

node.name: Tags
node.description: Names for this digest.

config.empty_text: No tag is recorded for this image.

node.name: Anchore Image
node.description: One image: what Anchore records about it, its findings and its tags. Open it from the Images or Vulnerabilities page.

node.name: anchore — sbom-header
node.description: The selected image, for the SBOM page's heading row.

query: RETURN i.data.reference AS image, i.data.image_digest AS digest, i.data.analysis_status AS status

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: anchore — sbom-packages
node.description: The packages the selected image's SBOM lists.

query: RETURN p.data.name AS package, p.data.version AS version, p.data.ecosystem AS ecosystem, p.data.license AS license, p.data.purl AS purl

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: anchore — sbom-vulnerable
node.description: Packages of the selected image with a current finding, and how many.

query: MATCH (f:anchore__anchore_finding)-[:FOUND_ON_IMAGE__anchore]->(h:computing_core__host) WHERE h.data.stable_id = $digest AND h.data.realm = "oci-digest" AND f.data.state = "current"
RETURN f.data.package_name AS package, f.data.package_version AS version, COUNT(f) AS findings

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: anchore — sbom-documents
node.description: The SBOM documents recorded for the selected image.

query: RETURN d.data.format AS format, d.data.spec_version AS spec, d.data.component_count AS components, d.data.produced_at AS produced, d.data.generator AS generator, d.data.verified AS verified, d.data.verification_note AS note, d.data.content_digest AS content

digest.description: The image digest, such as sha256:ab12…

node.name: Image
node.description: The image this SBOM describes.

columns.title: Analysis

config.empty_text: Anchore holds no image record with this digest. Open an image from the Images page.

node.description: Section heading: The SBOM documents read from Anchore for this image, each identified by the digest of its content. Only the CycloneDX document is parsed, so a component count of 0 on the others means not counted, not empty. Anchore's documents are unsigned; the note says where each was read from.

node.name: Anchore Image SBOM
node.description: One image's software bill of materials: the packages with open findings, every package, and the documents they came from. Open it from an image page.

node.name: anchore — runs
node.description: Every collection run, newest first.

query: RETURN r.entity_id AS id, r.data.run_id AS run, r.data.started_at AS started, r.data.finished_at AS finished, r.data.selftest_verdict AS selftest, r.data.reported_version AS version, r.data.images_listed AS listed, r.data.images_selected AS selected, r.data.images_out_of_scope AS out_of_scope, r.data.scopes_read AS read, r.data.scopes_not_read AS not_read, r.data.inventory_stale AS stale

node.name: anchore — scanners
node.description: Every Anchore instance and account this grid has collected from.

query: RETURN s.data.api_root AS api_root, s.data.account AS account, s.data.reported_version AS version

node.name: Runs
node.description: Section heading: One row per collection run, newest first. Self-test is the collector's check that the instance answers as its published interface says. Read and Not Read count the scopes the run covered and the ones it could not: a scope not read means its data here is from an earlier run or absent, never that Anchore reported nothing. Open a run for the list of scopes it could not read and the reason for each.
